title: Meeting Buddy vocabulary
description: ~/Library/Application Support/MeetingAssistant/vocabulary.json, edited in the app (Slovník). Inspired by custom vocabulary (keyterms) and custom spelling of speech-to-text services.

aliases.description: How speech recognition writes it wrongly (custom spelling 'from').

description.description: Meaning of an abbreviation, role of a person … Context for the Claude cleanup only.

inPrompt.description: Put into Whisper's prompt (keyterm boosting). Only rare words; the prompt holds ~200 tokens.

autoReplace.description: Replace the aliases with the correct form right after transcription (whole words, case-insensitive). Off for aliases that are also common words.
